slot.brief: Convert a simple present or past tense sentence from active to passive voice (or identify the correct passive form among options); use a transitive verb with a clear object.

stem: Change the following sentence into passive voice: The committee approved the proposal after a brief discussion.
options: The proposal approved the committee after a brief discussion.
The proposal is approved by the committee after a brief discussion.
The committee was approved by the proposal after a brief discussion.
The proposal was approved by the committee after a brief discussion.
notes: from question bank gcfd403be195d (verified in job 20261127-135707-e087)
working:
The active object, “the proposal,” becomes the passive subject. Simple past “approved” takes “was approved”; the agent remains “by the committee.”

Independent check: The active sentence is simple past; passive voice uses “was approved,” with the proposal as the subject.
solution: The active object, “the proposal,” becomes the subject; simple past “approved” changes to “was approved.” The agent is introduced by “by”: The proposal was approved by the committee after a brief discussion.
